video_title: Head Coach Jordan Ott Postgame Media Availability  | 11-25-26

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on Kamaka's complete performance off the bench
quotes.excerpt: He just battled. I thought good minutes from a young dude that hasn't played in a ton of environments.
quotes.quote: Against a physical team with experienced bigs, all-star level bigs, Kamaka just battled. I thought good minutes from a young dude that hasn't played in a ton of environments like this, in a big game. So yeah, he hung in there and did well.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott praised Kamaka for his performance off the bench against a physical team, saying the young player really battled in a big game environment.

structured.context: Head coach Jordan Ott discusses the performance of Kamaka off the bench during the postgame media availability.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the team's 4-1 road trip performance
quotes.excerpt: We wanted this one too, wanted to be greedy to try to get to 5-0 on the trip.
quotes.quote: Overall, we were able to make some strides in the trip. We wanted this one too, wanted to be greedy to try to get to 5-0 on the trip. We knew it was a big game, knew it would be emotional, and we knew we wanted to test ourselves against one of the best teams in the West. We're competitors and wanted to close it out the right way.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott reflected on the Suns 4-1 road trip, noting that while the team wanted to go 5-0, they were happy to test themselves against one of the best teams in the West.

structured.context: Head coach Jordan Ott reflects on the team's 4-1 road trip performance following their recent game.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on managing possessions and team energy
quotes.excerpt: That was a big gap that we talked about at halftime, just our energy after they make a shot.
quotes.quote: It's not going to feel great all the time against a really good team. That second quarter we weren't able to stay with it long enough, then it turned into a bigger run than what it really could have been. That was a big gap that we talked about at halftime, just our energy after they make a shot. They're going to make shots, they're the number one offensive team and a really good defensive team when they're locked in, physical, healthy like they are.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on the second quarter struggles against a top offensive team: We were not able to stay with it long enough and it turned into a bigger run than it should have been.

structured.context: Head coach Jordan Ott explains the team's struggles with energy and defensive execution during the second quarter.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on managing foul trouble and rotation adjustments
quotes.excerpt: We were searching a little bit there for someone that wasn't in foul trouble.
quotes.quote: We were searching a little bit there for someone that wasn't in foul trouble. Dylan was in foul trouble there at the start of the third quarter so we pulled him a little bit early to then bring him back to start the fourth. Our fives ended up obviously in foul trouble, so we were trying to figure out the right combination.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott explains the rotation adjustments during the game, noting that foul trouble forced the team to search for the right combinations throughout the second half.

structured.context: Head coach Jordan Ott explains his rotation adjustments due to foul trouble involving Dylan and other players.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on Jaylen's impact and team rebounding struggles
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen's spurt there to start the fourth quarter kept us in it when Book was off the floor.
quotes.quote: I thought Jaylen's spurt there to start the fourth quarter kept us in it when Book was off the floor. We were definitely searching. I thought Ryan's minutes when he got in there were good, and Goody as always. We have to take a look, but sometimes we do downsize to the five. This is a tough team to do that against when they have 20 offensive rebounds, so we wanted to try to keep a five in. We'll definitely take a look.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott highlighted Jaylen's impact to start the fourth quarter but admitted the team struggled to combat the opponent's size after giving up 20 offensive rebounds.

structured.context: Head coach Jordan Ott discusses individual player impacts and the challenges of maintaining a traditional lineup against a strong rebounding team.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on defensive rebounding concerns moving forward
quotes.excerpt: We're 30th in defensive rebounding, struggled again and thought we were in it.
quotes.quote: It's always the glass. We're 30th in defensive rebounding, struggled again and thought we were in it, and then they got one on the free throw rebound. We're up against it every night. How do we find a way to offset the possession game because we're just getting crushed on the defensive glass?
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott is concerned about the team's defensive rebounding struggles, noting they are currently 30th in the league and need to find a way to offset the possession game.

structured.context: Head coach Jordan Ott addresses the team's ongoing struggles with defensive rebounding and possession management.
